rows.grounds: relative pronoun referring to the desired object

items.question: Is the attainment of every manifold desired goal certain and beyond doubt?
premises: One indeed obtains the desired result.
There is no doubt regarding this attainment.
Whatever manifold goal is desired can be attained.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner certainly attains every manifold desired goal without doubt.
uncertainties: The specific subject 'one' is implied by the verb form rather than explicitly stated.
items.plain_english: One indeed obtains whatever manifold thing is desired; there is no doubt.
